text:
ash: PTAL — I pushed a follow-up to address the review comments on the API PR. Removed the transient `uuid` dep, tightened the OpenAPI shape for /v1/generate (behind a feature flag), and fixed a flaky macos lint failure. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-inference/pull/4382

tyler: quick skim — overall looks fine. curious if we need a migration note for internal clients?

ash: added a short CHANGELOG entry and a migration snippet in docs/observability. It's gated by `enable_new_api_v1_shape` so should be opt-in for now. still would like a staging smoke run before canary.

jess: I can run staging smoke tomorrow AM. what's the exact flag name so I can toggle?

ash: flag is `enable_new_api_v1_shape`. also added a unit test for the serializer edge-case that tripped earlier.

infra-bot: CI: linux/amd64 ✅, docker-integration ✅, macos-lint ❌ — rerun queued (flaky test skip added in latest).

maria: left one nit about serializer naming (camelCase vs snake_case) — not a blocker, but prefer camelCase for API responses to match existing endpoints.

ash: addressed that nit and pushed branch `fixup/serializer-casing` — PTAL.

tyler: LGTM from me once CI is green. if jess can confirm staging, we should do a 1h canary then full merge.

jess: staging smoke passed, no regressions observed. I'll keep eyes on canary for the first 60m.

ash: thanks — planning to merge in ~30m and kick off canary. tag me if anything odd shows up. :tada: :shipit:

tyler: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

ash: noted, will follow up with a short rollout note in #eng-oncall with the canary group and flag toggle instructions.
